label: Aruba Instant On AP11 (RW) 3x3 11ac Wave2 Indoor Access Point (R2W96A)
description: Aruba Instant On AP11 (R2W96A) - dual-radio 802.11ac Wave 2 indoor AP, 2x2:2 on both bands (300 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 867 Mbps 5 GHz). Single 1G RJ45 uplink with 802.3af PoE-in or 12 V DC. Runs Instant On cloud/mobile management and can act as a Wi-Fi gateway/router.
